description: The typical (median) current price of a job (task) across models, and the n models closest to it - what a normal price for this job is. Same arguments as cheapest_models_by_task.

component.description: input_tokens (default), output_tokens, or the task's own unit

scope.description: all (default), specialized (the task's own category) or multi/universal (qualifying llm models - the two names mean the same set, WP-0086)

task.description: what the buyer wants done: text (chat/LLM), vision, image, video, tts (speech from text), stt (text from speech), embedding, rerank, moderation - a job, not a model type (search_offers' category is the model type)

name: median_price_by_task
